dedupe_keys.name: technical potential of salt caverns for hydrogen storage in europe

description: Dilara Gülcin Caglayan and colleagues publish a European hydrogen-storage potential layer for salt caverns, with values expressed in gigawatt-hours per square kilometre. The Zenodo record supplies one GeoJSON file, identifies the associated International Journal of Hydrogen Energy article and labels the release 16 October 2019. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The describing paper assesses suitable salt formations, land exclusions and thermodynamic storage capacity, distinguishing onshore and offshore scenarios. These are estimates of technical potential, not an inventory of constructed or permitted hydrogen stores. Exact feature geometry, coordinate system and spatial discretisation remain unknown from the landing-page metadata. The layer can constrain regional storage capacity in hydrogen-system planning simulations, subject to the study's geological and siting assumptions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this layer. The GeoJSON was not downloaded and the capacity calculations were not reproduced.
